speaker: Doctor

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Burning pain in neck and arms, and weakness in both hands. I also have Paresthesias in hands, Absent reflexes, Decreased hand grip with fasciculations.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of fasciculations and absent reflexes is concerning for motor neuron involvement, so I need to rule out structural causes first. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Cervical_Spine

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: A syrinx (cavity) within the spinal cord extending from the cervical to the upper thoracic region.

speaker: Doctor
text: The MRI confirms a syrinx extending from the cervical to the upper thoracic region, which explains your pain, paresthesias, and weakness. This condition is known as Syringomyelia. DIAGNOSIS READY: Syringomyelia
